verdict.rationale: Milvus's own docs say Milvus Distributed runs on a 'massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in production', so production Kubernetes deployment is a first-party mode. However, nothing in the pack mentions an official Helm chart or Kubernetes operator. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official Helm chart or operator, install/upgrade documentation for Kubernetes, independent or hands-on corroboration of a production K8s deployment.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator

citations.quote: Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in production
